summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing updates on its $1 billion share repurchase program. The company provides daily ASX transaction disclosures under the program. Repurchases cover both Class A and Class B common stock. Management expresses intent to repurchase from time to time, subject to market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investment opportunities. No specific pricing, dates, or amounts in the filing. The filing is a routine disclosure obligation. Watch for quarterly updates on buyback pace and impact on share count.
